decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housing builds directly on the firm's drainage housing and installation know-how, enabling it to interpret results and improve the product.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's core drainage systems and bathroom expertise, so absorptive capacity supports continued learning and improvement.
As the flagship designer shower drainage product, it aligns with the firm's design and engineering capabilities, giving it the knowledge to refine and keep it.
Integrated slope shower elements extend the firm's core drainage and installation knowledge toward accessible solutions, so the firm can assimilate feedback and improve.
Backflow-protected basement floor drains leverage proven drainage technology and technical installation knowledge, allowing the firm to evaluate and improve.
Air-admittance valves are far from the firm's core drainage and manufacturing knowledge, limiting its ability to interpret results and improve, so the product should be dropped.
